description: "Sermons on Evil-Speaking" by Isaac Barrow is a collection of ethical discourses written in the late 17th century. The work compiles several sermons that address the issues of slander, idle talk, and the inappropriate use of language, emphasizing the moral and social consequences of such behaviors.
